question: What is the meaning of neighbourhood stats in relation to object characteristics (objective registered data related to circularity)?
data_group: object characteristics (objective registered data related to circularity)
description: Neighborhood stats in relation to object characteristics refer to the statistical data associated with the surrounding area or environment where the object is located. These statistics are part of the objective registered data related to circularity, providing insights into the local context and conditions that can impact the sustainability and circularity of the object.
